ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the distal two-thirds of both lobes. A solid black vertical band is centered at the median. High-frequency black mottling and focal spotting are concentrated along the trailing edge and lower-central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 145 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary; distinct jagged peaks and deep serrations are concentrated at the distal terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical S-shaped curve with primary convexity on distal trailing edges and concavity leading toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of yellowish-white circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the left and right terminal tips and along the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) are visible traversing the high-intensity white region of the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips and distinct parallel rake-mark scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and asymmetrical pigmentation pattern where the right lobe displays a significantly higher density of dark interstitial mottling compared to the left lobe.
